title: Interstate transfer fee.
bodyText: The judiciary may assess a fee not to exceed $200 for each application made by a parolee or probationer for a transfer out of the State.
bodyHtml: §353B-6  Interstate transfer fee.  The judiciary may assess a fee not to exceed $200 for each application made by a parolee or probationer for a transfer out of the State. [L 2008, c 172, §1; am L 2012, c 303, §1; am L Sp 2021, c 9, §42]
